map.由质量与加速度求驱动力 使用指南: Driving Force from Mass and Acceleration User Guide
map.输入移动平台质量 m 与所需加速度 a，工具按 F=m·a 计算驱动力，叠加摩擦: Enter the mobile platform mass m and required acceleration a, and the tool computes driving force as F = m·a; adding friction and slope gives the thrust needed for motor selection, for power system design of AGVs and conveyors.
map.输入质量 m 与加速度 a，求驱动力。: Enter mass m and acceleration a to get driving force.
map.：总推力=20N+摩擦阻力，须覆盖地面/传动损耗。: : total thrust = 20 N + friction resistance, which must cover ground and transmission losses.
map.由扭矩与角速度求机械功率: Mechanical Power from Torque and Angular Velocity
map.由转动惯量与角加速度求所需扭矩: Required Torque from Moment of Inertia and Angular Acceleration
map.理想无摩擦匀速只需克服阻力，F≈0（仅抗摩擦）。: Ideal frictionless constant speed only needs to overcome resistance, so F ≈ 0 (only against friction).
map.须加 m·g·sinα 分量。: A m·g·sin α component must be added.
